verdict.rationale: Floot's core product is natural-language chat-based app building ('build and ship full-stack apps without leaving your AI chat', 'turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app'), with rich agentic tool support (get_logs, query_database, create_checkpoint, generate_image) operable via NL commands. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no detail on limits of NL command coverage for advanced operations.
